[media]
# 🐾 THIS AIRPORT HAS RULES. YOU HAVE INSTINCTS. 😈

Step into the paws of a highly trained (mostly) airport security dog in a premium VR experience where order meets absolute chaos. You'll have more than 70 missions to clear (and counting!)

**✈️ INSPECT. DETECT. GET DISTRACTED.**

Every mission puts you on duty in a busy airport. Search luggage, sniff out contraband, and identify suspicious passengers… or get sidetracked by literally everything around you. 🎒👀

[media]

**🧠 CLEAR RULES. CHAOTIC OUTCOMES.**

Each level gives you structured missions—but sometimes your instincts have other plans. Chase a scent, knock things over, follow the wrong lead… success is never straightforward.

[media]

**😂 COMEDY YOU CAN’T CONTROL**

Your movements are the joke. Sniffing, grabbing, bumping, reacting—every action can spiral into unexpected, laugh-out-loud moments. You’re not trying to cause chaos… but you will. 💥

[media]

**🌍 A SERIOUS PLACE, FROM A NOT-SO-SERIOUS POV**

Airports are strict, stressful, and full of rules. Now experience them through curiosity, distraction, and pure dog energy. 🐕✨

[media]

**🔥 EVERY SHIFT IS A DIFFERENT DISASTER**

No two missions play the same. Mistakes, surprises, and unpredictable behavior turn every run into a story worth sharing.

**🐕 GOOD DOG. BAD TIMING.**

You’re here to keep the airport safe.
What could possibly go wrong? 😏

Meet other K-9s and plan your next mischief at **https://discord.gg/yZbJWwRuW**
